newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up in range-bound trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed marginally higher in quiet trading on Monday, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.6 points up at 741.9. Price gains outnumbered declines by 35 to 17. National Development Bank rose 1.25 rupees to 215.25 and Hayleys four to 249.
"Prices are moving beyond the reach of small retailers and large investors are unable to get big quantities as sellers hold out," said Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips Securities.
Brokers say sellers are holding out as earnings per share forecasts for Colombo stocks have been upgraded.
